Class BaseSearchTree<N extends BaseSearchNode<N>>

java.lang.Object
org.engine.ai.BaseSearchTree<N>
Direct Known Subclasses:
IsmctsTree, MctsTree
public abstract class BaseSearchTree<N extends BaseSearchNode<N>> extends Object
Base class for MCTS-style search trees.

Owns the root node, simulation bot, exploration constant, and per-player global margin bounds used for UCT score normalisation.
